# Psalm 60 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 60:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-God, You-have-rejected-us; You-have-broken-through-us; You-were-angry — restore-us!
- **LOGOS:** O God, You have rejected us, broken our defenses; You have been angry; oh, restore us.
- **PNEUMA:** You have rejected us, O God, and broken our defenses. You have been angry with us; now restore us to Your favor.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 60:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-have-given to-those-who-fear-You a-banner, to-rally because-of truth. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** You have set up a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee to it from the bow. Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** But You have raised a banner for those who fear You — a rallying point in the face of attack. Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 60:1 (overlap: 3%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Upon Shushan-Eduth [Lily-of-the-Testimony]. A-Miktam of-David, for-teaching, when-he-fought with-Aram-Naharaim and-with-Aram-Zobah, and-Joab returned and-struck Edom in-the-Valley of-Salt — twelve thousand.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. According to Shushan Eduth. A Miktam of David, for instruction, when he strove with Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and when Joab on his return struck down twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David, to be sung to the tune of 'Lily of the Testimony.' A Miktam. David wrote this when he was at war with Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and killed 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** You-have-made-the-land tremble; You-have-torn-it-open. Heal its-breaches, for it-totters.
- **LOGOS:** You have made the land to quake; You have torn it open; repair its breaches, for it totters.
- **PNEUMA:** You have shaken our land and split it open. Seal the cracks, for the land trembles.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** You-have-shown Your-people hard-things; You-have-made-us-drink wine of-staggering.
- **LOGOS:** You have made Your people see hard things; You have given us wine to drink that made us stagger.
- **PNEUMA:** You have been very hard on us, making us drink wine that sent us reeling.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
